email.body1:
Alan, saw Zuma is scaling Kelsey across the full resident lifecycle, with results like $19M+ in lease revenue at Case & Associates.

Proof points like that usually pull in more in-market operators than a revenue team can cover before interest cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Zuma off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alan, quick follow-up for Zuma.

As Kelsey expands into rent collections and voice AI, the addressable operator list grows faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Zuma needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alan, last bit of proof for Zuma.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zuma's reply rate likely compares to other proptech AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Zuma either way.
